description: Scores one Spotify playlist for bot and fake-follower risk. Returns the playlist (id, name, curator, followers, tracks, url), botRisk.score from 0 to 100, botRisk.level (low, medium, high or editorial) and the warning factors behind the score (follower-to-track ratio, generic naming, sudden follower spikes and similar). Use it when the question is about a single playlist, such as one an artist is about to pitch to or has just been added to. For a whole list pasted from Spotify for Artists after a distributor artificial-streaming warning, use scan_warning_playlists instead: it ranks up to 50 playlists in one call. Limits: 3 checks per visitor per day, with no sign-in. Read-only: it reads public Spotify data and changes nothing apart from the daily usage count, which is refunded if Spotify fails. Errors: INVALID_PARAMS (not a playlist link), NOT_FOUND (deleted or private), SPOTIFY_PLAYLIST (Spotify-owned editorial or algorithmic playlists, which the API does not expose), UNVERIFIABLE, RATE_LIMITED (daily allowance used).

playlist.description: Spotify playlist to look up, in any of three forms: a share URL ("https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1PmwMQY86pJuAm7veFt3u2", query strings such as ?si= are ignored), a URI ("spotify:playlist:1PmwMQY86pJuAm7veFt3u2") or the bare 22-character base-62 id ("1PmwMQY86pJuAm7veFt3u2"). Album, track and artist links are rejected with INVALID_PARAMS.

name: check_playlist
